title: Open-Order Factor for Freight Rebookings by Order Age - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Training note - Large Item Freight Delivery rebookings, Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

The open-order factor on a freight rebooking fee counts calendar days from the order's placed date to today.

| Calendar days since the order's placed date | Open-order factor |
|---|---|
| 35 or more | 0.6 |
| 28 or more, but fewer than 35 | 0.8 |
| Fewer than 28 | 1 |

The factor multiplies the rebooking amount; 0.6 keeps 60% of it and 0.8 keeps 80%.

### Questions answered

**From which date are the days counted?** From the placed date on the order record, in calendar days, to today.

**Does the threshold day belong to the higher band?** Yes. On day 28 the factor is 0.8; on day 35 it is 0.6. On day 27 it is 1; on day 34 it is 0.8.

**Does a new appointment date change the count?** No. The days run from the placed date, not from the promised date.

**Example (hypothetical).** A freight order placed 40 days ago, with a rebooking amount of $74.00 before this factor, is charged $74.00 times 0.6, that is $44.40.
